entries.source: Monumenta Zollerana. 6, Urkunden der Fränkischen Linie
entries.german: Engelhard und Eberhard von Rosenberg und Heintze Knebel von Bretzekeim bekennen, daz sy zwischen hern Conrade von Hartheim und Gotzen von Hedekeim, wegen eines hengstes, den Gotze hern Conrade in des Burggreben dienste von Noremberg gelyhen, dergestalt gerichtet haben, daz Gotze von Hedekeim seinen hengest wider nam und her Conrad yme uf Sant Petirs tag nehest vergangen ad Cathedram funfzehen Guldin dazu bezalte. Datum anno domini Millesimo trecentesimo nonagesimo nono. ipso die Walpurgis virginis.
entries.english: Engelhard and Eberhard von Rosenberg and Heinrich Knebel von Bretzenheim acknowledge that they have settled the dispute between Lord Konrad von Hartheim and Gotze von Heddesheim concerning a stallion, which Gotze had lent to Lord Konrad in the service of the Burgrave of Nuremberg, in such a way that Gotze von Heddesheim took his stallion back and Lord Konrad paid him fifteen guilders for it on the most recently past St. Peter's Day "ad Cathedram." Given in the year of the Lord one thousand three hundred ninety-nine, on the very day of Walpurga the virgin.
facts: Engelhard von Rosenberg served as arbitrator in a dispute between Conrad von Hartheim and Gotze von Hedekeim
Eberhard von Rosenberg served as arbitrator in a dispute between Conrad von Hartheim and Gotze von Hedekeim
Engelhard and Eberhard von Rosenberg worked together with Heintze Knebel von Bretzekeim as co-arbitrators
Engelhard and Eberhard von Rosenberg resolved a dispute involving a horse loan in the service of the Burggraf of Nuremberg
